category_title: Medicated student struggling with ADHD diagnosis and agency
minimal_context: Dennis is participating in a Danish lesson where the class is using a camera with a cardboard cover.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dennis, you took the cardboard cover off the camera. The instruction was to leave it on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I do bad things. I am noisy.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Since you didn't follow the instructions, you need to go sit in the chair in the corner by the blackboard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: In school they keep an eye on me all the time, so that I do not do stupid things. All the time, I am afraid of doing stupid things and being yelled at.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just sit in the corner and face away from the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Accepts being put in the corner in a chair at the blackboard, head faced away from class) I didn't mind. Then I do not have to be afraid of doing stupid things.
